scope: source-driven field diagnostic, no newly fitted crop or hydraulic coefficients
reasons: Initial state date, mineral N and residue conditions not verified; organic stocks are a 2014-to-January proxy.
PTF retention is estimated, not a measured retention curve; conditional water depth mapping remains.
Single year, four repeated blocks, regional weather; this is not independent multi-year climate validation.
Source seeding rate, hybrid, tillage, P/K, incidental spray N, pests and tile/water-table processes are not all represented in the reduced model.
This diagnostic does not validate rye, clover, oat or cross-strategy economic effects.
